venture.resumen: My brand for web solutions and digital automation for businesses: landing pages, integrations, cross-tool workflows, and clear documentation so the implemented solution can be maintained.

servicios.descripcion: Pages focused on explaining services, capturing leads, and building trust from the first click.
Automations between forms, spreadsheets, emails, and tools to reduce manual work.
Connecting platforms via APIs and webhooks to avoid duplicate data and operational errors.
Organized handoffs so the business understands how to use, review, and maintain the solution.

proyectos.descripcion: Web catalog of algorithmically generated abstract art. Allows the creation of unique pieces through procedural builders and Cloudflare Workers AI models.
proyectos.impacto: Complete serverless architecture with a public gallery and private admin dashboard. Uses databases (D1) and storage (R2) to efficiently manage the image and vector catalog.

proyectos.descripcion: Web tool to generate and manage automated quotes. Integrates Gemini IA (Google GenAI) for editing and suggesting persuasive texts.
proyectos.impacto: Streamlines the sales process through real-time PDF generation, data management with Supabase, and AI assistance to improve proposal writing.

proyectos.descripcion: Online store demo with product catalog, shopping cart, checkout, and integrated payment flow.
proyectos.impacto: Practical showcase of an e-commerce solution to sell products or services, featuring a catalog, cart, product dashboard, optimized images, checkout, and payment gateway.

proyectos.descripcion: WordPress e-commerce developed with a custom theme, WooCommerce Blocks, custom authentication, Chilean checkout, and Flow integration through a custom adapter plugin.
proyectos.impacto: Showcases a complete commercial implementation: reusable theme, custom plugins, email verification registration, Chilean regions/communes, cart, checkout, and ready-for-Flow payment reconciliation.

proyectos.descripcion: Web system for reporting and managing micro-dump hotspots, with authentication, user roles, and a management workflow for municipal/community tracking.
proyectos.impacto: Django backend, authentication, roles, forms, database, and deployment.

proyectos.descripcion: Public news portal that consumes content endpoints and presents articles, categories, and an editorial archive in a web interface deployed on Vercel.
proyectos.impacto: News frontend, endpoint consumption, categories, dynamic content, and deployment.

proyectos.descripcion: Multi-tenant software for healthcare professionals and small clinics. Centralizes patients, appointments, availability, online booking, and role-based management.
proyectos.impacto: Includes public booking, data isolation per organization, overlap prevention, and exportable PDF/Excel reports.

proyectos.descripcion: Commercial landing page offering digital automation, websites, integrations, and practical workflows for small businesses.
proyectos.impacto: Converts my technical offer into a clear commercial presence, with services, process, plans, and direct WhatsApp contact.

proyectos.descripcion: Site for an advertising studio focused on graphic design, printing, branding, corporate materials, digital marketing, and websites.
proyectos.impacto: Presents services, visual portfolio, process, WhatsApp contact, and a high-contrast graphic identity for direct sales.

proyectos.descripcion: Self-managed commercial site for a floral business in La Serena. Uses Sanity CMS for independent catalog management, custom bouquets, and special collections.
proyectos.impacto: Organizes a broad visual catalog dynamically managed by the client. Features real photos and converts inquiries into orders coordinated directly via WhatsApp.

proyectos.descripcion: Professional landing page for forensic social work practice serving Family Courts. Outlines expert evaluation areas, methodology, ethical principles, and direct contact channels.
proyectos.impacto: Clean, accessible editorial layout optimized for conversion and fast WhatsApp inquiries, featuring fluid Motion animations, responsive design, and Vercel deployment.

proyectos.descripcion: Dashboard for the tech reporting agent: gathers AI, Cloud, and event news, summarizes/translates them with AI, and prepares Telegram deliveries.
proyectos.impacto: Includes reports dashboard, history, metrics, bot configuration, and automated deliveries at 08:00 and 18:00 Chile time.

proyectos.descripcion: Virtualized environment with simulated machines and networks for auditing, isolated testing, and technical practice with Linux systems.
proyectos.impacto: Enables practice in networking, hardening, SSH, and analysis in a controlled environment.

proyectos.descripcion: Conversational workflows to guide scheduling through NLP and webhooks connected to a booking backend.
proyectos.impacto: Organizes conversations and prepares clean data for the backend.

proyectos.descripcion: Backend API to receive images via base64 or URL, process them with AI models, and return a newly generated output.
proyectos.impacto: Exposes AI processing as a consumable service for other systems.

proyectos.descripcion: Applied work on an institutional site, providing tech support, technical documentation, and basic customer service automation.
proyectos.impacto: Reinforces experience in a real environment handling requirements, user support, web maintenance, Java, chatbot, and documentation.

proyectos.descripcion: Redesign, maintenance, and support of a WordPress e-commerce site, focused on commercial presence, catalog, payments, and web operations.
proyectos.impacto: Hands-on work with WordPress administration, visual editing, hosting, SSL, migration, content, store management, and operational support.

proyectos.descripcion: Totem-style system to guide users via a web interface, backend, database, and AI assistance in the service flow.
proyectos.impacto: Combines interactive experience, backend, data, and cloud deployment to resolve automated guidance in an on-site context.
